comment: Machine-readable shape of BUGS.json at skill version 1.4.2. Read this when a BUGS.json records a different skill_version than the installed skill: there is no backwards compatibility, so the agent holding the file upgrades it or rewrites it.

title.note: the defect in one line, stated as what goes wrong

severity.note: how bad it is when it happens

priority.note: when it gets fixed; a separate judgement from severity

parent.note: a defect this is a facet of

mechanism.note: required once status is confirmed or later

surfaces.note: every file that has to change

verification.note: required when status is fixed; names the mutation that fails without the fix

invariants: every parent names an existing id
a fixed entry has a verification
a confirmed entry has a mechanism
if_no_schema_for_a_version: Rewrite the file from the current schema rather than guessing the difference. Carry every reproduction across verbatim: it is the one field that cannot be reconstructed later.
